description: Waiters aren't served in order, so small messages can starve a large one
A cancelled waiter keeps its place, and everyone behind it waits for ever
old:
/\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ line' = Without(line, r)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, used>>
new:
/\ want' = [want EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
    /\ line' = line
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, used>>

description: A message is posted whatever the budget holds
Taking a message doesn't give its bytes back
A message waits for room even when nothing is held, so a largest one waiting behind none never goes
